Chiang Mai Counseling provided me with a safe, non judgemental, compassionate environment, where I could finally address the root causes of my alcoholism and drug addictions.
Brett, through his own personal experience and training, enabled me to explore a greater understanding of addiction, hence enabling me to be very comfortable in his presence.

Finally, and most importantly in my opinion, Brett has extensive knowledge and experience in accessing and healing the root cause of addiction, childhood trauma.

I've been working with Brett for several months now, and my life has changed dramatically.

I would recommend Brett to people struggling with addictions or just unable to understand the source for their unhappiness.

Keep up the good work Brett,
